external_entities.name: duty engineer
external_entities.description: An engineer who uses the dispatch console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state how an engineer signs in to the dispatch console.

external_entities.name: scheduling partner
external_entities.description: Another company that publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company, publishes tomorrow's planned work.
external_entities.notes: The text does not state how the partner identifies our importer or how the importer identifies the partner.

processes.name: dispatch console
processes.description: A single-page JavaScript application used by duty engineers and connected to the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: The console is a single-page JavaScript app
processes.notes: The text does not state how an engineer signs in to it. CORS origins and credential handling are not recorded. WebSocket TLS, handshake authentication, and post-connection session checks are not recorded.

processes.name: corporate web host
processes.description: The host that serves the dispatch console.
processes.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it
processes.notes: The text does not state where the corporate web host runs.

processes.name: dispatch API
processes.description: The API called by the dispatch console and schedule importer; it reads and writes the dispatch database.
processes.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
processes.notes: The control plane is not reachable from the internet. The API allows cross-origin responses, but the allowed origins and credential setting are not recorded.

processes.name: schedule importer
processes.description: An importer that pulls the partner's SOAP feed, parses XML, archives downloaded documents, and posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API.
processes.source_excerpt: Our schedule importer runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The text does not state how the partner identifies the importer or how the importer identifies the partner. The API token was issued when the importer was built and has not been rotated.

data_stores.name: dispatch database
data_stores.description: A database containing job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and the token or session that created each job order.
data_stores.source_excerpt: That database holds the job orders, the crew names and the crew mobile numbers.
data_stores.notes: Every job order carries the token or session that created it, and nothing about the person behind that token. Protection at rest is not recorded.

data_stores.name: schedule archive
data_stores.description: A folder where the importer writes each downloaded partner document.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive
data_stores.notes: The text does not state the archive's protection at rest or its network placement.

data_stores.name: corporate file store
data_stores.description: The corporate file store containing the schedule archive folder.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a folder on the corporate file store
data_stores.notes: The text does not state the file store's network placement or protection at rest.

data_flows.name: open console
data_flows.description: A duty engineer opens the dispatch console in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They open the dispatch console in their browser.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state the protocol or authentication mechanism.

data_flows.name: serve console
data_flows.description: The corporate web host serves the dispatch console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: our corporate web host serves it

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The dispatch console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console calls the dispatch API.
data_flows.notes: The API answers the console cross-origin; allowed origins and whether credentials are allowed are not recorded.

data_flows.name: live job status
data_flows.description: The dispatch console opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API for live job status.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The console also opens a WebSocket to the dispatch API and holds it open for live job status.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state whether the socket runs over TLS, whether its handshake is authenticated, or whether it checks the engineer's session again after opening.

data_flows.name: read and write
data_flows.description: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The dispatch API reads and writes the dispatch database.
data_flows.data_description: job orders, crew names, crew mobile numbers, and creating tokens or sessions

data_flows.name: publish planned work
data_flows.description: The scheduling partner publishes tomorrow's planned work through its SOAP feed, which the importer pulls.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A scheduling partner, which is another company, publishes tomorrow's planned work.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state how the partner identifies the importer or how the importer identifies the partner.

data_flows.name: write documents
data_flows.description: The schedule importer writes downloaded XML documents into the schedule archive.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes each document it downloads into the schedule archive

data_flows.name: post work orders
data_flows.description: The importer posts parsed work orders to the dispatch API using an API token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The importer then posts the parsed work orders to the same dispatch API the console calls.
data_flows.notes: The importer presents an API token. The token was issued when the importer was built and has not been rotated since.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where duty engineers sit and the schedule importer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Duty engineers sit on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: production control plane
trust_boundaries.description: The control-plane zone holding the live estate and authority to move a crew or change a depot's work for the day.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The dispatch API runs in the production control plane.
trust_boundaries.notes: The control plane is controlled by the same company and staff but holds authority that a corporate laptop does not.

trust_boundaries.description: The trust zone controlled by the scheduling partner, which is another company.
